_README: Annotated caregiver FREE-TEXT gold set for the advisory NLP layer. 100% SIMULATED / synthetic, CONFIDENTIAL - stays in this folder. Each item: id, text, and gold findings as [field, value] pairs. Fields: side_effect (canonical concept), seizure_duration_bucket (under_1min|1_3min|over_3min|over_5min), seizure_frequency ('N per_day|per_week|per_month' or bucket daily|weekly|monthly), red_flag (breathing|prolonged_seizure|spreading_rash|unresponsive). Negation/historical/other-experiencer/hedged items intentionally have NO positive finding (tests precision + abstention). Some phrasings are deliberately at the edge of lexicon coverage so recall is not trivially 1.0.
